component.name: Lunday
component.summary: Unofficial Monday.com desktop client for Linux

description.p: **This is a community package of Lunday and is not officially supported by monday.com.**
Lunday is an unofficial Linux desktop client for monday.com built with GTK and WebKit.

It adds desktop-focused integration on top of the web app, including secure credential storage, native notifications, persistent preferences, theme and zoom controls, and a configurable notification sound.

ul.li: Stores login credentials securely with Secret Service integration.
Bridges web notifications to native desktop notifications.
Remembers navigation state, theme preference, zoom level, and other app settings.
Lets you choose and preview a custom notification sound from a file picker.

screenshot.caption: Lunday main window showing the Monday.com workspace

ul.li: Improved overall desktop integration and metadata.
Refined the application experience for current Flatpak builds.
